week_title: JavaScript reboot: syntax, functions and debugging
primary_courses: JavaScript: The Hard Parts v3 + targeted javascript.info refresh
concepts: Variables/const/let, functions, arrays, objects, control flow, references, debugger breakpoints
exit_criteria: Explain and trace code, write 5 small functions with edge cases, and run them without AI.

primary_courses: JavaScript: The Hard Parts v3
concepts: Execution context, closure, callbacks, promises, async/await, event loop, error propagation, prototypes at a high level
exit_criteria: Explain a closure and event-loop ordering; independently debug an asynchronous failure.

primary_courses: Total TypeScript Pro Essentials
concepts: tsconfig strict, inference, unknown vs any, unions, literal types, narrowing, optional properties
exit_criteria: Typecheck without suppressions or blanket any; explain narrowing and trade-offs.

primary_courses: Total TypeScript Pro Essentials
concepts: Function overloads vs unions, generics, keyof, indexed access, utility types, reusable API types
exit_criteria: Create two useful generic helpers and explain why the type constraints are safe.

primary_courses: Total TypeScript Pro Essentials + selected Effective TypeScript
concepts: Mapped/conditional types at working level, type guards, runtime validation boundaries, module interfaces
exit_criteria: Pass strict compilation and explain where runtime validation remains necessary.

primary_courses: CSS for JavaScript Developers + MDN
concepts: Semantic HTML, forms, accessibility labels, cascade, specificity, inheritance, box model, block/inline layout
exit_criteria: Form works by keyboard; layout does not overflow; can explain the box model.

primary_courses: CSS for JavaScript Developers + Tailwind official docs
concepts: Flexbox, Grid, positioning, stacking contexts, responsive sizing, media/container query basics, mobile-first design
exit_criteria: Responsive dashboard works at mobile/tablet/desktop sizes; explain layout choices.

primary_courses: Epic React v2 Fundamentals + Complete Intro to React v9 only if stuck
concepts: JSX/TSX, components, props, events, local state, list keys, rendering, composition; Tailwind setup
exit_criteria: Implement typed components, interactive filters and correct React list keys independently.

week_title: React state, forms and UI accessibility
primary_courses: Epic React v2 Fundamentals/Hooks + targeted CSS modules
concepts: Controlled inputs, state updates, lifting state, reusable hooks, focus management, aria semantics, validation
exit_criteria: Form errors, keyboard navigation, focus restoration and tests behave correctly.

week_title: React effects, data fetching and shared state
primary_courses: Epic React v2 Hooks + selected Complete Intro React v9 TanStack lessons
concepts: Effect dependencies, lifecycle mental model, async race conditions, custom hooks, server vs client state
exit_criteria: Handle error, retry and stale data without unsafe effects or duplicate fetch logic.

primary_courses: Testing Fundamentals + Epic React testing sections
concepts: Vitest, React Testing Library, user interactions, assertions, mocking network, integration vs unit
exit_criteria: Run tests deterministically and explain why each test adds value.

week_title: Frontend MVP and first practical interview
primary_courses: Epic React selective exercises + Complete Intro React v9 targeted ecosystem
concepts: Routing fundamentals, client-side navigation, performance, accessibility audit, component architecture
exit_criteria: Demonstrate frontend end-to-end without AI and explain state and testing decisions.

primary_courses: Introduction to Node.js v3 — Scott Moss
concepts: Node runtime, CommonJS/ESM, process/env, fs, async I/O, streams basics, error handling
exit_criteria: Explain Node event loop, module imports and asynchronous file operations.

primary_courses: Introduction to Node.js v3 completion + API Design in Node.js v5
concepts: HTTP verbs/status codes, routes, middleware, REST resource modeling, query/body/path inputs
exit_criteria: API can be exercised from curl and has predictable validation and error responses.

primary_courses: API Design in Node.js v5
concepts: Zod validation, centralized errors, input normalization, security basics, integration testing
exit_criteria: Endpoints reject invalid input safely; tests cover success and failure cases.

primary_courses: API Design in Node.js v5 + Web Security v2 selected auth lessons
concepts: Sessions vs tokens, password hashing, authN vs authZ, access control, least privilege, CSRF/CORS
exit_criteria: A second account cannot access first account data; explain security model.

primary_courses: Complete Intro to SQL & PostgreSQL — Brian Holt
concepts: Tables, keys, constraints, normalization, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, SELECT, joins, GROUP BY
exit_criteria: Write required CRUD and aggregate queries by hand, without ORM assistance.

primary_courses: Complete Intro to SQL & PostgreSQL + selected DDIA indexing/transactions chapters
concepts: Indexes, EXPLAIN, ACID, isolation, lost updates, transactions, unique constraints, migrations
exit_criteria: Demonstrate reliable concurrent update and explain chosen isolation behavior.

primary_courses: API Design v5 / SQL review + Drizzle official documentation
concepts: ORM schema/migrations, parameterized queries, pagination indexes, frontend/API integration, data ownership
exit_criteria: FeedbackHub MVP works with persisted data and no cross-account leaks.

week_title: NestJS fundamentals: controllers, modules and DI
primary_courses: Tom Ray — Master NestJS by Building Real-World Projects, Project 1
concepts: Nest CLI, modules, controllers, providers, dependency injection, DTO validation, pipes
exit_criteria: Explain Nest request lifecycle and DI; isolated Nest API passes tests.

primary_courses: Tom Ray — Master NestJS, Project 1 + relevant database lessons
concepts: Guards, interceptors, middleware, exception filters, roles, authN/authZ, Prisma/Drizzle choices
exit_criteria: Unauthorized and edge-case requests are tested; design boundaries explained.

week_title: NestJS testing, background work and architecture
primary_courses: Tom Ray — Master NestJS, selected testing and project lessons
concepts: Testing modules, provider mocks, lifecycle hooks, queues/jobs overview, structured errors, dependency inversion
exit_criteria: Nest service is demonstrably tested; publish architecture trade-off note.

primary_courses: Next.js Fundamentals v4 + official Next.js Learn
concepts: Server vs Client Components, routes/layouts, SSR, data access on server, environment boundaries
exit_criteria: No unintentional duplicated business logic; can explain data-flow boundaries.

primary_courses: Next.js Fundamentals v4 + official documentation
concepts: Server Actions, Route Handlers, authorization on server, caching/revalidation, streaming basics
exit_criteria: Understand the lifecycle of a mutation and demonstrate correct auth and refresh behavior.

week_title: Browser E2E, web security and observability
primary_courses: Playwright: Automated Testing & AI Workflows + Web Security v2
concepts: Browser E2E, fixtures, roles/auth, XSS, CSRF, SQL injection, secret handling, structured logging
exit_criteria: E2E checks reliable in CI-like environment; no known critical auth/data leakage.

primary_courses: Docker and GitHub Actions official docs + targeted Full Stack Open container/CI lessons
concepts: Dockerfiles, Compose, build vs runtime config, secrets, migrations, CI checks, rollback basics
exit_criteria: Fresh checkout can run via documented commands and CI passes.

week_title: Launch a narrow MVP and conduct discovery
primary_courses: PostHog Product Engineer Handbook + practical user discovery notes
concepts: MVP scope, customer interviews, activation metrics, privacy-aware event instrumentation
exit_criteria: User can submit and process feedback on a deployed app; observations documented.

primary_courses: PostHog docs: events, funnels, feature flags + feedback interviews
concepts: Instrumentation, funnels, activation, cohorts basics, qualitative/quantitative synthesis, prioritization
exit_criteria: Analytics events demonstrably fire; iteration hypothesis and measurement plan documented.

week_title: Ship an iteration and write the case study
primary_courses: PostHog docs + project refactoring / selected Refactoring chapters
concepts: Iteration, performance/accessibility pass, operations checklist, architecture storytelling
exit_criteria: Show before/after behavior and evidence; no fabricated business metrics.

primary_courses: Ultimate Design Patterns + Refactoring.Guru + NestJS notes
concepts: OOP, composition, SOLID, Strategy, Factory, Adapter, Dependency Injection
exit_criteria: Pass a 45-minute LLD mock and discuss complexity and extensibility.

primary_courses: System Design Primer + selected DDIA and project architecture docs
concepts: Requirements/SLAs, database indexes, caches, queues, event delivery, trade-offs, failure recovery
exit_criteria: Present a coherent 45-minute design and defend consistency/reliability choices.

primary_courses: Front End Interview Handbook + existing app/test suites
concepts: Time-boxing, clarifying requirements, test-driven debugging, React feature and Node endpoint practice
exit_criteria: Complete a working scoped feature under time pressure with sensible trade-offs.

week_title: Full interview loop and portfolio readiness
primary_courses: NeetCode/Tech Interview Handbook + your portfolio documentation
concepts: Mock coding, systems, low-level design, behavioral/product stories, CV and project narrative
exit_criteria: Demonstrate readiness against the final skills rubric; start/continue targeted applications.
